_meta.description: Current Few-Shot Bank state: active exemplars, their query classes, recency scores, and relevance scores. Accessible to all agents without routing through the Orchestrator.
_meta.update_policy: Updated via cdi_update.py when Promotion Gate approves a new exemplar. Requires Promotion Gate authorization — not direct write.

output.accepted_output: Investigation of coordinated multi-account API abuse should always start from a graph-topology query before falling back to per-account rates. The rule is: never recommend population-wide rate limits when the elevated signal is concentrated in fewer than 5% of accounts; recommend targeted cluster action instead. Going forward, every investigation in this class must report cluster share, rate ratio, and financial concentration together.

exemplars.justification: Strong rule language introduced (4 signal(s), e.g. 'always start'); distance 0.16

output.accepted_output: Experiment analysis should always check SRM before reading the effect estimate. The rule is: never propose a ship decision when chi-square SRM test rejects assignment balance, regardless of nominal effect size. For all experiments below 80% power, report MDE alongside the point estimate, and by convention flag novelty effect risk when treatment ramp is under 7 days.

exemplars.justification: Strong rule language introduced (4 signal(s), e.g. 'always check'); distance 0.20

output.accepted_output: Pipeline diagnosis should always check PSI before output-drift assertions. The rule is: never escalate to L3 when L2 healing cycles have not exhausted the cross-domain repair catalogue. For all gradual-degradation cases, the minimum causal chain must be logged before remediation, and going forward every cycle records the analogue domain used.

exemplars.justification: Strong rule language introduced (4 signal(s), e.g. 'always check'); distance 0.18

promotion_gate.description: Exemplars are promoted from analyst corrections/approvals to the Few-Shot Bank only when: (1) the correction is unambiguous, (2) the Statistician Agent validates the exemplar's correctness, (3) the exemplar generalizes beyond the single case that prompted it.
